title: test(app-shell): page inspector hides data-view sections for list pages (ADR-0047)
body:
## What

Adds a regression test for the metadata-admin **page inspector** section visibility (ADR-0047): given the framework PR #1817 page-form shape, a `type: 'list'` page must hide **Data Context** + **Layout** (`visibleOn: "data.type != 'list'"`) and show the **Interface** section (`data.type == 'list'`); a `record` page does the inverse.

`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/SchemaForm.pageVisibility.test.tsx` — 2 cases (list page, record page).

## Why

ADR-0047 follow-up. Investigation showed **objectui was already correct** — `SchemaForm`/`SectionedSchemaForm` honor section `visibleOn`, and the page draft carries `type`. The original "Data Context still shows" symptom was a **stale backend** serving the pre-#1817 form, not a renderer bug. This test pins the renderer side of the contract so a future regression is caught.

Renderer-only verification — **no source change**. Complements the existing `SchemaForm.collapsible.test.tsx`.

## Verification

- Ran locally: `vitest run SchemaForm.pageVisibility.test.tsx SchemaForm.collapsible.test.tsx` → **5/5 pass**.
- Browser-verified end-to-end against a backend containing framework #1817 (`showcase_task_workbench` list page hides Data Context + Layout, shows Interface; `showcase_project_detail` record page shows them).
